claims.text: Immune response modifier: induces local cytokines and a brisk inflammatory reaction
claims.quote: Imiquimod is an immune response modifier that stimulates local cytokine induction, resulting in a brisk local inflammatory reaction.
First-line treatments include topical fluorouracil (5-FU) cream and imiquimod cream.

claims.text: 5% cream 2 times a week for 16 weeks was effective and safe in a randomized trial
claims.quote: A randomized trial showed that Imiquimod 5% cream applied 2 times a week for 16 consecutive weeks is effective and safe (4).
